pgss_query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC,s.queryid) AS ordinal,s.queryid::text AS queryid,r.rolname AS role_name,s.calls,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3) AS mean_ms,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,1) AS total_ms,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,1) AS max_ms,s.shared_blks_hit,s.shared_blks_read,s.temp_blks_written,s.temp_blks_read,s.rows,CASE WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'WITH%' THEN 'WITH' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'SELECT%' THEN 'SELECT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'INSERT%' THEN 'INSERT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'UPDATE%' THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'DELETE%' THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS kind,lower((regexp_match(s.query,'dic_[a-z0-9_]+','i'))[1]) AS dic_identifier FROM pg_stat_statements s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid WHERE s.calls>0), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE ordinal BETWEEN 721 AND 800) SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'stats_reset',(SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_statements_info),'total_active_fingerprints',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE calls>0),'selected',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected) ORDER BY ordinal) FROM selected)) AS evidence

realtime_full_sql_definitions.name: list_changes
realtime_full_sql_definitions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
realtime_full_sql_definitions.full_ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal'
AS $function$
  WITH pub AS (
    SELECT
      concat_ws(
        ',',
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END
      ) AS w2j_actions,
      coalesce(
        string_agg(
          realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass),
          ','
        ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL),
        ''
      ) AS w2j_add_tables
    FROM pg_publication pp
    LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname
    WHERE pp.pubname = publication
    GROUP BY pp.pubname
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- MATERIALIZED ensures pg_logical_slot_get_changes is called exactly once
  w2j AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables
    FROM pub,
         pg_logical_slot_get_changes(
           slot_name, null, max_changes,
           'include-pk', 'true',
           'include-transaction', 'false',
           'include-timestamp', 'true',
           'include-type-oids', 'true',
           'format-version', '2',
           'actions', pub.w2j_actions,
           'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables
         ) x
  ),
  slot_count AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt
    FROM w2j
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
  ),
  rls_filtered AS (
    SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors
    FROM w2j,
         realtime.apply_rls(
           wal := w2j.data::jsonb,
           max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes
         ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors)
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
      AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt
  FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc

  UNION ALL

  SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt
  FROM slot_count sc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered)
$function$
realtime_full_sql_definitions.verdict: Publication table-filtered logical-slot reader uses a materialized batch and apply_rls before returning subscribed rows; this audit did not invoke slot reading.

realtime_full_sql_definitions.name: list_changes_sync
realtime_full_sql_definitions.args: publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer
realtime_full_sql_definitions.full_ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes_sync(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal'
AS $function$
  WITH pub AS (
    SELECT
      concat_ws(
        ',',
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END
      ) AS w2j_actions,
      coalesce(
        string_agg(
          realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass),
          ','
        ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL),
        ''
      ) AS w2j_add_tables
    FROM pg_publication pp
    LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname
    WHERE pp.pubname = publication
    GROUP BY pp.pubname
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- MATERIALIZED ensures the slot is read exactly once.
  consumed AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables
    FROM pub,
         realtime.settled_changes(
           slot_name, max_changes,
           'include-pk', 'true',
           'include-transaction', 'false',
           'include-timestamp', 'true',
           'include-type-oids', 'true',
           'format-version', '2',
           'actions', pub.w2j_actions,
           'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables
         ) x
  ),
  slot_count AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt
    FROM consumed
    WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> ''
  ),
  rls_filtered AS (
    SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors
    FROM consumed,
         realtime.apply_rls(
           wal := consumed.data::jsonb,
           max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes
         ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors)
    WHERE consumed.w2j_add_tables <> ''
      AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt
  FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc

  UNION ALL

  SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt
  FROM slot_count sc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered)
$function$
realtime_full_sql_definitions.verdict: Distinct settled_changes route gates not-yet-visible WAL transactions before apply_rls; not a proven duplicate of list_changes.
